sources.title: Discover Dominica Authority (legacy site): Film Trade
sources.said: The Dominica Film Office can offer the following services: … assistance with obtaining a film license, work permit exemptions, visa waivers, … duty free exemption on all capital and other goods used for filming … The Film Office provides assistance in obtaining a waiver of import duties and taxes on equipment and supplies to be used in production. … FILMS AND TELEVISION PROGRAMS SHOT IN DOMINICA … The Orchid House by BBC Channel 4 (1991)

figures.finding: producer-DM.json (Discover Dominica Authority film-trade page): the Film Office names no cash rebate, tax credit or film fund; whether its waivers apply to a series was not read. A legacy page (undated); whether the current Discover Dominica site keeps it was not checked. producer-DM.json already holds it as the film terms.

value.incentive: no rebate or credit; the Film Office helps obtain duty-free import of goods used in filming and work-permit waivers
value.appliesToSeries: not stated; the page lists television programmes among works shot there
